slides.title: Your website in 5 clear stages.
Order received.
slides.body: You choose a plan or ask for a quote. Your project is confirmed and queued.

slides.title: In development.
slides.body: We design and build your site, and you can follow every step from your portal.

slides.title: Review.
slides.body: You get a live preview and tell us what you think, directly in the project chat.

slides.title: Revision.
slides.body: We apply your changes. Revisions are included in every plan.

slides.title: Delivered.
slides.body: Your site goes live. You get everything you need to run it.

slides.title: Start at stage one.
slides.body: Tell us about your project and get a clear plan and delivery date.
